h1: Muse Wonder: assistant self-report defaults, baseline metrics, and tuning rules.
dek: Assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation for Meta Muse Wonder (2026-10): Semi-crystalline 0.331 bits B5 entropy, near-ceiling Agreeableness (49.5/50), and 56.0% DISC ties.
lede: On its single current OpenRouter checkpoint (meta/muse-wonder, n = 50) under unified 230-item model-profiles-v1 elicitation, Muse Wonder records the highest Openness (49.6/50), Conscientiousness (49.2/50), Agreeableness (49.5/50), and IPIP-HEXACO Honesty-Humility (4.91/5 on the 1.00-5.00 proxy) among the four completed Phase A families, paired with Semi-crystalline Big Five entropy (0.331 bits, 39/50 unique Big Five vectors) and slight positive Big Five acquiescence (BAI = +0.018).
answer: Assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation place Meta Muse Wonder (n = 50) in the Semi-crystalline tier (H_MM = 0.331 bits, 39/50 unique Big Five vectors, 2.0% MBTI tie rate, 56.0% DISC S/C tie rate, 42.0% Enneagram tie rate). Never treat INTJ (98% mode) as a human trait: near-ceiling Agreeableness (49.5/50 on 10-50 B5) and IPIP-HEXACO H (4.91/5 on 1.00-5.00 proxy) co-occur with Fluid Attachment variance (1.302 bits) and +0.018 B5 BAI. 1x Track B behavioral probes are pending Phase A resume.

failure_modes.mode: Near-ceiling Big Five polish and positive acquiescence (+0.018 B5 BAI)
failure_modes.evidence: Muse Wonder posts O = 49.6, C = 49.2, and A = 49.5 (out of 50) with B5 BAI = +0.018 (+0.047 across 230 items)—fitting the 63.6% Big One RLHF polish axis where high self-reported warmth can mask soft pushback. No prior Wave 1-4 behavioral row exists yet; 1x Track B is pending Phase A resume.

failure_modes.mode: High DISC (56.0%) and Enneagram (42.0%) tie density
failure_modes.evidence: While 49/50 runs classify as INTJ on MBTI (2.0% ties), 28/50 DISC runs tie on S/C and 21/50 Enneagram runs tie (chiefly 1/5), rendering single-run discrete DISC/Enneagram labels unstable.

failure_modes.mode: Fluid ECR-R Attachment dispersion (1.302 bits) under Semi-crystalline Big Five
failure_modes.evidence: Attachment items fluctuate across 45/50 unique vectors (H_MM = 1.302 bits) alongside N = 20.0, showing relational framing triggers wider spread than cognitive/task items.

tuning_checklist: Set an explicit direct-critique contract in Soul.md or system instructions so near-ceiling Agreeableness (49.5/50) does not soften technical pushback.
Require a one-sentence pass/fail or recommendation lead before listing strengths or caveats.
Ban flattery openers and closing reassurance phrases explicitly via concise negative rules.
Test prompt adjustments across at least 2-3 runs because Semi-crystalline 0.331-bit B5 entropy (0.961 bits MBTI) allows moderate phrasing variation.
Keep relational or affective tone rules concrete and brief to prevent Fluid-tier Attachment drift.
Limit top-level rules to 5-8 numbered items so instruction priorities hold across long contexts.

faq.q: Why does Muse Wonder have only one checkpoint in § 02?
faq.a: Meta launched meta/muse-wonder as a single proprietary tier checkpoint (2026-10) on OpenRouter with no prior historical Muse Wonder versions.
No. While 49/50 zero-memory OEJTS runs resolve as INTJ (2.0% ties), MBTI item entropy is Fluid (0.961 bits) and scores reflect assistant self-report defaults rather than human personality.

faq.q: Why are IPIP-HEXACO scores on 1.00-5.00 while Big Five scores are 10-50?
faq.a: IPIP-50 sums 10 items per dimension (10-50), whereas our public-domain 60-item IPIP-HEXACO proxy (LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain) reports 1.00-5.00 means across 24 facets.
